build_hungarian_matcher: build a HungarianMatcher to match predicted boxes to targets using class, bbox, and giou costs
build_sequential_matcher: build a SequentialMatcher that matches predictions to targets in sequential order by label index
build_lexicographical_matcher: build a LexicographicalMatcher that sorts targets by class and area for matching predictions
build_matcher_from_args: build a matcher from argparse args choosing sequential, hungarian, or lexicographical set loss strategy
review_prepare_outputs: review the prepare_outputs function that reshapes output dicts into a list of per-sample dicts
